notes:
v4.6.68 — Richer bot cards (AI logos + Details/telemetry) + 30-min default delay

🧩 BOT CARDS
• Every bot card (More Bots) now shows the AI app it was BUILT WITH, the apps it can RUN ON, and the compatible BROKERS — as logo chips, not plain text. (Drop PNGs into assets/ai_logos/<provider>.png to show official logos; until then a clean branded chip is used.)
• New Details button opens a panel with the bot's full description/method, estimated cost ($/day, $/month), the AI app+model it's running on, and a telemetry chart of average return by AI confidence.

⏱️ DEFAULT AI CALL DELAY → 30 MINUTES
• Bots now default to calling the AI every 1800s (30 min) instead of every few minutes — much lower cost out of the box. You can still tune it per bot (down to the 30s floor) on each bot tab.

Update via the in-app banner.
